Andrew I work in college athletics as a Director of Marketing. 1 year and 1 month ago I was diagnosed with Severe Depression and anxiety. This has been the most difficult year of my life. I fight every day to not let it show as I get better. I’m 29. It’s time to #EndTheStigma

Leaving Athletics and SUU to begin my mental health recovery was one of the hardest decisions of my life. I cannot help but wonder how different my life would be if I had reached out to someone when my depression started.

November was an incredibly dark month where there were multiple potentially suicidal episodes. I was stuck in my own mind. I couldn’t get over my depression but pressed forward with my work. The job I loved was all I had.

My depression worsened the more I pushed through and came to a crisis point many times. I lost all motivation and could barely focus. I kept grinding and instead of asking for help I kept it all to myself and distanced myself from those who could have helped.
